bridgeRouteRisk.summary: mUSD is an M0 extension token deployed at the same address on Ethereum, Linea, and Monad. Every mUSD unit is minted by wrapping M0's $M one-for-one, verified on-chain by mToken() and by $M balances held inside the mUSD contract. Ethereum is the hub: $M there is minted by the M0 MinterGateway with no proxy and no portal, so mUSD on Ethereum is native issuance. On Linea and Monad the local $M is a cross-chain representation whose sole mint authority is the M0 Portal at 0xd925c84b55e4e44a53749ff5f2a5a13f63d128fd, and essentially all local $M sits inside the mUSD wrapper, so those deployments carry M0 Portal burn-mint bridge risk.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Pharos V9 Phase 3 curation lane cur-4

routes.protocol: M0 extension minted by wrapping hub-native $M
routes.reviewNote: Verified on-chain at Ethereum block 25575129: the mUSD proxy reads name 'MetaMask USD', 6 decimals, and mToken() 0x866a2bf4e572cbcf37d5071a7a58503bfb36be1b. That hub $M has a zero EIP-1967 implementation slot, no portal(), and minterGateway() 0xf7f9638cb444d65e5a40bf5ff98ebe4ff319f04e, so it is minted natively on Ethereum rather than bridged in. The mUSD contract holds 12,301,332.20 $M against 12,301,156.85 mUSD outstanding, confirming one-for-one hub wrapping with no inbound bridge leg.

routes.protocol: M0 Portal (burn-mint cross-chain $M) wrapped into the local mUSD extension
routes.reviewNote: Verified on-chain at Linea block 31455579: mUSD reads name 'MetaMask USD', 6 decimals, and mToken() 0x866a2bf4e572cbcf37d5071a7a58503bfb36be1b. Local $M is a proxy whose portal() returns 0xd925c84b55e4e44a53749ff5f2a5a13f63d128fd, the M0 Portal that is its sole mint and burn authority. Local $M total supply is 7,592,236.26 and the mUSD contract holds 7,592,225.76 of it against 7,592,108.58 mUSD outstanding, so effectively all Linea $M backs mUSD and the deployment inherits M0 Portal bridge risk.
